lines.text: an apparatus is the decision that something counts as a result
elasticity is not a property of the object — it is a negotiation between the object's internal forces and whatever touches …
lines.note: a spring cannot supply its own rest length — the norm is written in before the first frame, so what the cube calls equilibrium is obedience to a shape it can never inspect.

lines.text: a carousel is a centrifuge for compliance — the soft bodies do not choose their shape
lines.note: compliance cannot rotate itself: every hanging body needs a rigid hub and a pin it did not choose, so the shape it finds is an answer to a question the arm asked first.

lines.text: a curtain is not a surface — it is an array of constraints negotiating gravity
a mushroom cap does not decide its shape — the pin constraint
a room that breathes is no longer a container — it is a body, and you are inside it
lines.note: a wall can only breathe against something that does not — the floor, the obstacle, the sine driving it — and the whole cost of every meeting is paid by the side built to yield.

lines.text: a flag is not a symbol displayed — it is a material surface negotiating wind
Part 2 of the soft body test gallery
lines.note: the gallery cannot deduce what a soft body will do, only stage it — and these twelve cells are one slice of a rack chosen by an index, so what nobody racked is not merely unseen but unaskable.

lines.text: the softbodies chapter says form is not imposed
lines.note: the cloth cannot choose its own clock: the CFL step shrinks as stiffness rises, so rigidity costs compute — and the four sculptures in the room are four seconds a timer picked, not four shapes.

pearls.edge: a room with no instructions teaches nothing on its own — it can only spend intuition five earlier maps deposited, so a body arriving here first finds objects, not a playground.

lines.text: Procedural radiolarian skeleton generation — the impossibly intricate silica structures of single-celled organisms
lines.note: the skeleton cannot show the softness that made it: the protoplasm has withdrawn and the map hands you only the residue, so the process must be imported or the beauty reads as design.

lines.text: pattern emerges from the ratio of two diffusion rates
identical cells under identical rules stay identical forever. Every pattern here is the
lines.note: form without former still needs a former for its two numbers: feed and kill are typed in from outside, and the symmetry only breaks because someone seeded noise the chemistry cannot make.

lines.text: morphogenesis is not construction — it is what happens when entropy finds a threshold where disorder crystallizes into …
lines.note: the gyroid is continuous and the room is not: marching cubes touches the field only at grid vertices and guesses between them, so every passage finer than the sample spacing was never built and cannot be missed.

pearls.edge: the empty catalyst slot only reads as a refusal to someone who arrives expecting one — the chamber cannot supply the habit it withholds, so the argument is lost on anyone who came here first.

lines.text: Small bronze pedestal + glowing stake + Label3D reading SOFT BODY
lines.note: the catenary is not the cloth's — hand the same curve to a chain or a cable and it appears unchanged, so what the room shows belongs to the two pins, and the fabric is interchangeable.

pearls.pearl: softbody sb02 cloth drape top row
pearls.edge: pin the whole top and there is nothing left to emerge; the one thing that still curls is the outermost column, and it curls because the lattice ran out of neighbours, not because cloth does that.
there is no air in this room — wind is a constant vector dotted with each face normal, so the flag is pushed and never pushes back: no wake, no shelter behind it, no gust it caused.
the dome hangs over a table that is not there — the four pins supply every symmetry in it and the cloth supplies none, so pull one pin and the surface being shown stops existing.
cube-ness lives in twenty-eight springs and nowhere in the cube: pull one and the solid becomes a sheet or a string, so the shape is a count, and the count has no margin.
the collapse is one number, not a material: topology says what could happen and stiffness says which of those does, and the room can only show the consequence, never the value that chose it.

pearls.pearl: softbody sb07 jelly grid tall stiff
pearls.edge: standing costs stiffness, and stiffness is what the integrator cannot afford: push k high enough for the column to hold and the same number that keeps it upright is the one that detonates the timestep.

the phase change this room claims is a band, and the band is between the rooms: sb07 stands, sb08 flows, and the settling-but-misshapen middle where the transition actually happens is in no map at all.

the plant's shape is a word borrowed from another gallery; this room can only add what the grammar never said — stiffness, gravity, sixty steps — so the standing posture is made entirely of what the rule left out.

pearls.pearl: softbody sb ls02 plant wind collapse
pearls.edge: the same word stands in the drawing and falls here: a grammar cannot supply weather, so what killed this plant was never in its letters — the genotype survives intact in the wreckage and explains none of it.
conway never had a body in mind, so nothing in the rule guarantees the graph stays connected — whether this cloth hangs or tears is decided by a seed, and the rule takes no credit either way.

pearls.pearl: softbody sb ca02 life without death cloth
pearls.edge: this fabric is strong because nothing in it is allowed to die — density here is not weaving but the absence of an eraser, and run the rule far enough and the grid fills solid and stops being a pattern.
the cracks are painted, not computed — the springs settled and a noise field was sampled over them afterwards, so nothing broke; the gemstone lives only in an eye that reads voronoi as fracture.

the room claims pattern and material are one thing, then couples them in one direction only: chemistry stiffens the cloth, the cloth never bends the chemistry back, because closing the loop is what costs.
the chemistry runs on the cloth's own vertices, so no stripe can be finer than one spring is long: the pattern's resolution is welded to the fabric's, and a mark needs a spring to be drawn on.
the bulb is blown by nothing: pressure is a scalar pushed along face normals, so there is no gas inside, no cooling, no breath — the vessel records three numbers and the record is mistaken for craft.
this bottle has no rest state to reach — at step 380 it is still falling, so the vessel is a number someone typed, and there is no shape the simulation was heading toward to be right about.
nothing forms this bowl's rim: it is the ring the world held fast, and the vessel is only the leftover below it — widen the pin and there is less body to shape, not more bowl.
the vase is not leaning — down was moved. the tilt lives in the gravity vector and not in the body, and nothing in the finished shape can tell you which of the two was rotated.

the other four become a family only because this one fails, and the physics has no opinion about which is which: the word broken comes from the eye, and the simulation records the same kind of fact either way.

pearls.pearl: softbody gm01 bottle in cylinder mould
pearls.edge: the cavity has already decided the bottle and the body only has to arrive: no glass, no heat, no surface tension, no release from the wall — just a projection step doing the work of a factory.

pearls.pearl: softbody gm02 vase in tapered mould
pearls.edge: the amphora exists in the cavity before any body enters it, and any body would do: the taper is the design, softness is only a delivery mechanism, and the vessel says nothing about what it was made of.

pearls.pearl: softbody gm03 box in cube mould
pearls.edge: the mould gives this box every flat face and not one corner — the corner radius is bending stiffness made visible, so the only part the body authored is the part where it failed to comply.
turn the mould inside out and nothing changes — cavity or obstacle, the sheet only records a geometry it did not author, and here even the pins are gone, so it holds on to nothing at all.
